fusions.name: Lifted Purse
fusions.desc: A quick tendril strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: False Shoreline
fusions.desc: Raises a false reef around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 35% chance to turn the target against its allies for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mottled Shallows
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Sly Nettle
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
